tofu.build: 5c3e46c4 with the TOFU-1382 budget change, built in scratch, 3 live runs
tofu.evidence: 2026-10-14 go-dev: Acceptance 1, longedit, tofu-sonnet, 3 alternating live runs per build behind the rivalslot, HEAD 5c3e46c4 archived LF (tofu.exe sha 3a5911d1) against HEAD plus source_budget.go only (sha 7058707f), rows in scratchpad t1382/head/bench/rivals/runs. Columns: wall s, requests (conversation + memory aux), total input, out, refused, quality. CHANGE: r1 75.4 12 (7+5) 171,005 7,986 2 10; r2 119.0 20 (14+6) 335,958 11,413 3 10; r3 78.5 12 (6+6) 156,947 7,126 2 10; median 78.5 s, 12 requests, 171k. HEAD: s1 141.0 26 (19+7) 488,794 13,854 10 10; s2 146.7 24 (16+8) 429,355 17,292 13 10; s3 136.8 24 (16+8) 433,468 17,497 19 10; median 141.0 s, 24 requests, 433k. omp (TOFU-1370): 91.4 s, 7, 126k. Quality 10 in every run. tofu now beats omp on wall (78.5 vs 91.4 s) and ties it on conversation requests (7 vs 7 median) but still loses total requests 12 vs 7 (5 to 6 are memory-model Haiku calls, cmd/tofu/memory_tree.go:173) and input 171k vs 126k. r2 spawned go-dev after a refused shell sed: the library rule still says a second directory goes to a sub-agent.
